statement: Street purchase price for a single H200 SXM module is quoted at $30,000-$40,000, and an 8-GPU HGX server at $350,000-$420,000, as of August 2026.
why: The document gives a price range with no baseline or stated change, so this is a static hardware price level rather than a movement.

impact.mechanism: Secondary-market hardware pricing shows what buyers pay outside allocation channels and serves as a confirmation overlay on merchant-GPU scarcity.

evidence.excerpt: Also notes hardware purchase prices: single H200 SXM module '$30,000–$40,000' street price; 8-GPU HGX server '$350,000–$420,000' street price.

confidence.basis: Secondary aggregator blog quoting unattributed street prices as a range; no dealer quote or filing behind the figures.

dispersion: Quoted as a range: $30,000-$40,000 per H200 SXM module; $350,000-$420,000 per 8-GPU HGX server.
